title: Rey
description: Rey thought she was a nobody abandoned on Jakku. When the Force awakened in her, she tried to turn her back on the fate the galaxy had for her but couldn't. After training as a Jedi under Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa, Rey learned the truth of her parentage - a descendant of Sheev Palpatine - but overcame it. Ultimately, she was able to eschew her bloodline and take up the mantle of Skywalker.
